findings.issue: 'On the eve of a possible invasion' carries uncanny timing precision: at the 00:00 UTC 24 February cutoff nobody could know an attack was hours away, so 'eve' leaks what happened about 03:00 UTC.
findings.resolution: Rewritten as 'With an invasion feared but not launched', keeping the invasion strictly a pending risk; note why_lead aligned.

findings.issue: UKTN's evergreen 'best stocks and shares to buy today' list (n1593) is generic and does not show attention to the correction or to leverage; the paragraph's attention evidence was thin for a leveraged-ETF lead.
findings.resolution: Replaced with Wolf Street's 18 February margin-debt headline (n1135: margin debt plunged, leverage still gigantic) as positioning evidence tied to TQQQ's borrowed exposure; Mahaney (n1719), Canstar (n1533) and the HOOD card move retained. n1135 was cited once before (2022-02-21, DWAC smart-money paragraph) and is used here only as context, not as the repeat's new evidence.

findings.issue: The five-session TQQQ -21.22% vs Nasdaq 100 -7.60% comparison was offered as proof that the daily reset 'erodes value', but in a one-way fall the figures show roughly triple exposure, not decay; the leveraged-decay caution also repeated the 2022-02-04, 02-11 and 02-22 TQQQ items almost verbatim.
findings.resolution: Recast: the analog now tests the 'shocks that do not dent earnings' premise against the energy channel (Brent 96.84 USD/bbl, card) and states the card figures as amplification of the path; the reset point is kept to one clause.

findings.issue: 'the Fed is tightening into the drawdown' - no hike had occurred by the cutoff; the cited evidence (n1801, n1850) is about a pending March lift-off.
findings.resolution: Changed to 'the Fed is preparing to tighten into the drawdown, not to rescue it'.

findings.issue: Closing 'One clean invalidation: an invasion that lifts volatility...' restated the paragraph's opening trigger ('The trade dies if the threat becomes an event').
findings.resolution: Redundant sentence cut; observable S&P 4,225.50 / VIX 31.02 triggers and the n1278 pending risk kept.

findings.issue: 'The war trade' phrasing presupposed a war that had not started at the cutoff.
findings.resolution: Changed to 'war-scare trade' in ITA, PLTR and wheat items; titles unchanged (the lead hook reads as a scare).

findings.issue: Checked all 24 cited IDs against the own-date feed: titles support the sentences, outlet names match src, all stamps precede the cutoff (day-granular 23 February items describe 22-23 February events: correction, state of emergency, separatists' request, Nord Stream sanctions context); n1801 (15 Feb Reuters poll) used as a policy baseline; n0093/n0445/n1533/n1135 within seven days. Every number matches the 2022-02-24 card (TQQQ, S&P, NDX, VIX points, 2Y and 20-observation bps with bear flattening, HOOD, LMT, GD, ITA, RTX/NOC direction, PLTR, wheat/corn/soy in US cents/bu, MOS, Brent) or a same-paragraph headline (ruble 3%, 80% Fastly, 40c/32c grains). No spot-FX, no invented posts or counts.
findings.resolution: No change needed beyond the edits above.

findings.issue: TQQQ (02-04 smaller, 02-11 lead, 02-22 smaller), LMT/defence (02-22), PLTR (02-18 lead), wheat (inside the 02-23 Brent lead) recur. Each needed new evidence and a new angle.
findings.resolution: Accepted: the TQQQ lead rests on evidence published after the 02-23 cutoff (n1908, n1909, n1719, n1281, n1282, n1278) and a new angle (dip-buying a pending invasion after the confirmed correction); ITA adds the FT two-leg ETF story (n0837); PLTR is secondary with Karp's 22 February line (n0558) and the CDC contract (n0564); wheat stands alone on 23 February evidence (n1703, n1714, n0715). Four distinct narratives: leveraged dip-buy, defence-plus-Russia ETF bet, growth-darling faith, food-supply premium.

scope_limits: Headline-level review only (no article bodies); day-granular 08:00 stamps were judged by content. Chronology compared with the current retail drafts and notes of 1-23 February only; earlier IDs were not resolved in earlier feeds, so prior-use checks rely on the earlier drafts' prose. No nonretail drafts, specs or other reviews read.

recommended_exclusions.reason: Reuters 'Expert views on Russian forces invading Ukraine' carries a 23 February day stamp but describes the invasion that began about 03:00 UTC on 24 February; not cited, but should not be usable by any 24 February section.

root_deltas.inserted: The war-scare trade has two legs, and the bargain-hunting crowd is tempted by both: beaten-down Russian assets and the defence primes that would supply any escalation.
